enrichment method: a strong reduction (19.7-fold) of UGP peptide counts in the enriched glycosomal fractions of the mutant
fractionation method: Enriched glycosomal fractions were loaded on a 10% acrylamide SDS-PAGE gel
instrument: nanoLC-MS/MS analysis on a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer
ionization type: Mass detection was carried out in the negative electrospray ionization (ESI) mode.
